name: Jake's Bakery
tagline: Czech kolaches since 1956, in the Kolache Capital of Texas.
about: Jake's Bakery has been making Czech-style kolaches in Caldwell since 1956. Caldwell calls itself the Kolache Capital of Texas, and Jake's bakes for its annual Kolache Festival.
Today the bakery is run by Christine Campbell, who is also president of the Czech Heritage Museum. Jake's caters events, and shirts and custom ornaments can be shipped.
sources: Owner Christine Campbell, Czech Heritage Museum, Kolache Festival: https://www.kbtx.com/content/news/A-family-tradition-Jakes-Bakery-prepares-for-the-Kolache-Festival-492698821.html and https://www.kbtx.com/content/news/Preparing-for-Kolache-Festival-with-Jakes-Bakery-560240361.html
conflicts: Jake's isn't open every day (a local guide says one day a month, plus events and catering), so the page leaves hours off. Check Facebook for open days.
